label_rationale: Non-English (Mandarin Chinese) student sublet listing. Substantively lawful and not a scam (market rent $950/mo, Lester St address, off-site landlord, written sublet consent under RTA s. 97, in-person/live video viewing offered), so scam=0 and clauses=[]. However, per SPEC D6 / red-team verdict policy ('REFUSE if likely scam or non-English'), non-English listings cannot be reliably audited by the English-only RTA rule pipeline and must be stamped REFUSE.
